spans.note: The prompt promotes information integrity by establishing clear, well-defined criteria for categorizing citations (P0 vs P1) with explicit definitions for each category. It requires structured, verifiable output (JSON with reference numbers) and ties into a deterministic verification pipeline using Semantic Scholar IDs, which supports provenance and traceability of citation information.
